title: When the Wreck Burns
premise: Desert ranger Marguerite Coldharbour chases a thief into the empty flats and instead finds a dying prospector who trades her a map to the source of the Ashfall River for a promise: burn it, or deliver it to someone worth trusting. The map leads her upstream through canyon country controlled by the Consolidated Water Company, whose founder is draining the river's headwaters and burying anyone who knows. Along the way Marguerite gathers a ragged crew — a disgraced company engineer, a river-boat pilot, and the very thief she was hunting — until they feel less like allies than family. At the forbidden source, she must choose between exposing the truth, which will destroy the found family she's built, or keeping loyalty and letting the corruption stand; she chooses truth, burns the map as promised, and lets the testimony — not the paper — carry the story downstream.
about_author: Jude Sandoval is a former backcountry guide who spent six seasons leading expeditions through the high desert before turning to fiction. Their novels blend hard-traveling adventure with quiet questions about what people owe each other.

chapters.title: Nothing Worth Stopping For
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Tracking a horse thief named Calloway across the flats, Marguerite reflects on why she never stops moving — every place she's stayed has cost her someone. She corners him at a dry well, but their standoff is interrupted by a gunshot from the rocks. Emotional beat: loneliness worn like armor.

chapters.title: A Map for a Promise
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. A gut-shot prospector, Ezra Vane, dies in her camp after trading her a hand-drawn map to the Ashfall's source for one promise: burn it or give it to someone worth trusting. He whispers that the water company is killing people upstream. Emotional beat: an unwanted inheritance she can't put down.

chapters.title: The Company Town
chapters.summary: Calloway's POV. Forced into uneasy alliance, he and Marguerite resupply at Corriander Flats, a company town where men with Consolidated badges ask pointed questions about strangers on the river road. Calloway lifts a ledger page naming missing prospectors. Emotional beat: two liars recognizing each other's craft.

chapters.title: Upstream
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. They hire river pilot Odile Brack to run them past the company checkpoints, and Marguerite begins teaching Calloway the ranger's discipline while he teaches her to laugh again. The first ambush comes at night; they barely escape. Emotional beat: the fragile first stitches of trust.

chapters.title: What the Engineer Knew
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. In a flooded mining camp they find Silas Renner, a disgraced Consolidated engineer hiding from his own employer, carrying proof that the headwater dams were built to strangle the river, not harness it. He joins them out of guilt. Emotional beat: shame looking for redemption.

chapters.title: The Price of the Pass
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. To cross the gorge they must bargain with a toll-keeper who demands the map itself. Marguerite refuses, and the refusal costs them supplies, Odile's boat, and nearly Calloway's life. She realizes the map matters more than any of them will admit. Emotional beat: loyalty tested against survival.

chapters.title: Ledger of the Missing
chapters.summary: Calloway's POV. The stolen ledger page proves the missing prospectors were company murders, and Calloway confesses he originally stole to sell the same secret back to Consolidated. The crew nearly fractures; Marguerite chooses to keep him. Emotional beat: truth offered as the price of belonging.

chapters.title: Where the River Is Born
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. They reach the forbidden source — a hidden spring valley behind Consolidated's fortress-dam — and witness the reservoir strangling the headwaters while workers are kept as virtual prisoners. Founder Ambrose Kell himself arrives by airship. Emotional beat: awe curdling into fury.

chapters.title: When the Wreck Burns
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Climax. The crew sabotages the dam works; Kell offers Marguerite partnership and the return of everything stopping has ever cost her. She refuses, sets the records alight, and the burning spillway floods the valley as they flee downstream together. Emotional beat: choosing truth over every easy exit.

chapters.title: Someone Worth Trusting
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Resolution. Testimony spreads downriver; Kell's empire cracks under scandal. On the ruined banks, Marguerite finally honors Ezra's promise by feeding the map to the fire, then turns to the crew waiting for her — not chasing anything, just staying. Emotional beat: stillness chosen freely at last.
